plan.notes: Sequence transcribed from the official Program Guide PDF (Program Guide link on the official program page, anokatech.edu/programs/machine-technology/; https://www.anokatech.edu/media/a00ds4na/machine-technology-3-certificate.pdf, retrieved 2026-10-01). The PDF template header prints '2018-2019' with 'Rev 2023' in the footer; the guide is the currently published program guide and its program name, sequence, and 16-credit total match the current official programs listing (Machine Technology Certificate, 16 credits). Admission requires successful completion of the Machine Technology 2 Certificate. The official guide labels the program's course block as 'Third Semester'; the semester label is preserved verbatim from the source. Students must earn a cumulative 2.0 GPA or higher to be eligible for graduation. Program starts Fall (August) and Spring (January). Course title 'CNC Programing II' is transcribed exactly as printed in the official guide. Certificates apply toward the CNC Manufacturing Technology diploma or AAS degree programs.
